evidence.quoted_text: for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(overrides)) child[name] = value;
evidence.reason: buildChildEnv copies allowlisted parent variables and then assigns overrides as literal property names. On Windows, environment names are case-insensitive, so an inherited PATH and an override Path can coexist in the same object; Node passes the lexicographically first case-insensitive match (PATH) to the child. The override therefore fails to win as the function's contract states, an implementation defect in existing intended behavior rather than a new requirement.
